QuestInfo.name: Sophia's Ambitions
QuestInfo.0: Sophia is making an Enhanced Transformation Potion out of Fire Boar's Teeth. Ask her how it's going.
QuestInfo.1: Sophia wants you to deliver her Enhanced Transformation Potion to 10 Boogies. Take it to him, and hope it doesn't make him croak...
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Sophia's Enhanced Transformation Potion to 10 Boogies.

0.0: Voila! I did it! My Enhanced Transformation Potion is complete! This alchemy business is a breeze, isn't it? Well, then, please take this to 10 Boogies.

yes.0: Be careful with that! Just take it to her straight away, okay?

no.0: Come by again when you have time.

1.0: How did the Enhanced Transformation Potion go? I've been waiting!

yes.0: She did it! How do I look? Now I can play with this a bit longer, and...wait a minute. Please see me again in a bit.

npc.0: Go on, take the Enhanced Transformation Potion to 10 Boogies.
